notes.title: Buy a game and get a swimsuit cotori stand!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055373/cb3eeeb9bd18cb7d4359c172a26dc9bbe8c4cb52.png[/img]

Hello, this is Eugene Games.
Buy a game or good, get a swimsuit coterie stand!
Please refer to the following for the detailed event!

1. Eligibility to apply - Grand Empire: the number of people who purchased the game of the graphics remaster (Steam, Stove, Secret Plus)
2. Buyers of goods and game keys sold at the Morphon Store are automatically applied to the event, so you do not need to apply for the event.
3. Application period: July 31 to August 8 at 23:59
4. Compensation
4-1. Three of the game buyers (applicants) will be drawn and one swimsuit cotori stand will be given
4-2. Two of the buyers of goods or game keys will be drawn and one swimsuit coaster stand will be given
5. If you win, please read the information mail delivered to the email address you applied for (delivery address input e-mail)
6. Delivery destination entry period: August 9 to August 18 at 23:59
7. We inform you of the difficulty of paying separate compensation after the writing period

Link to buy goods: https://mofun.cafe24.com/product/list.html?cate_no=164

Link to participate in the event (game buyers only): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTMhnOuYPyah8EfHQJIi0oEOprba1dFbWsJ359FUbylPjKQg/viewform

notes.title: Grand Empire: Starting the reviewer event of the graphics remaster~!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Eugene Games.
Grand Empire: Starts the reviewer event of the graphic remaster.
By August 23:59, we will select those who have left good reviews on the Steam store page and give you the following rewards, so please pay a lot of attention.

[list]
[*] Special award: Special digital signature of illustrator RAMU (1 person)
[*] Review Award: Starbucks americano Gifticon 1 sheet (3 people)
[/list]

※ For the winners, we will notify you additionally on August 9th, so we would appreciate it if you could check it. ※
